message.content:
A vertical rectangular illustration depicts a man's upper body and head from the chest up against a light grey background. He has tan skin, dark hair, and wears a black pinstriped suit with a grey collared shirt and black tie. His mouth is open, showing teeth. He holds two light brown wooden cross-shaped control bars, one in each hand. Each bar has four white strings extending downward. These eight strings are attached to two pale blue, curved, dish-like objects at the bottom, which resemble the pans of a balance scale. The man is positioned centrally, looking forward. 

White block letters across the bottom read “JALAN PINTAS SETYA NOVANTO”. Smaller white text below reads: “Ditengarai ada suap di balik pemilihan Ketua DPR dan pembahasan UU Pemilu Kepala Daerah. Pengakuan belasan saksi mata.” The word “TEMPO” is large and white at the top, partially obscured by the man's head. Smaller text includes “INVESTIGASI: JUAL-BELI ILEGAL PULAU-PULAU KECIL”, “OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2015: TANTANGAN KABINET KERJA”, and “3-9 NOVEMBER 2014”. A barcode and price are in the bottom right.
